title: Vortex Pink Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Pink Lemonade captures the tangy sparkle of Lemonade infused with the sweetness of Red Berries. This lively combination delivers a sweet, citrusy vape with a hint of fizz, creating a refreshing and uplifting flavour profile. With its 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid offers the perfect balance of smooth vapour and vibrant flavour, ideal for use in Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices like pod systems and starter kits. The nic salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, making it a great choice for all-day vaping. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts come in a 10ml format, offering a more economical and less wasteful alternative to disposable vape bars. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Pink Lemonade is perfect for vapers who love zesty, fruity flavours with a twist.
